19 words

apple
A round fruit that grows on a tree.
banana
A long fruit with yellow skin.
grapes
Small fruits that grow in a bunch.
orange
A round fruit with orange skin.
milk
A white drink that comes from animals such as cows.
bread
A food made from flour and water.
water
A clear liquid that we drink.
egg
A round or oval thing laid by a bird.
book
Pages joined together for reading.
bag
Something used to carry things.
pen
A tool that writes with ink.
cat
A small animal with fur and whiskers.
dog
An animal often kept as a pet.
fish
An animal that lives in water.
tree
A tall plant with a trunk and branches.
bird
An animal with feathers and wings.
sun
The star that gives Earth light and warmth.
car
A vehicle with wheels that carries people.
bank
bank
A place that keeps money for people.
